svg.title: rural-renew: evaluation-guided rural facade renewal
svg.desc: Four original image triptychs and the village-house illustration are preserved. The only-prompt baseline plans and edits once. Rural-renew uses six aspects and eighteen indicators plus regional building guidelines to plan modernization and local-character directions. Five-dimensional feedback guides a third proposal and selection. Every image is edited from the original.

g.text: Facade · Windows · Doors · Roof · Decoration · Environment
